_comment: gy-53qq5. Which BUILT files must state which of content's ruled prices. Keys name entries of `facts` in gymbo-canonical-strings.json; numbers are NEVER typed here, they are read from the facts at check time, so a price change (content bumps the fact) makes every listed file that still carries the old number go RED. Enumerated from dist/ (what ships), not from src/. A built file that states a current Gymbo amount and is NOT listed here fails as price-unregistered: list it or remove the price. `savePercent` files must also say 'Save N%' with N = annualSavingsPercent. Scope: html/md/txt/xml/json in dist; the .js bundles are not scanned (named gap).

thirdPartyAmounts._comment: A built file may legitimately state a current Gymbo amount for a NON-Gymbo reason (a competitor at the same rupee figure). Declare it here as { file, amount, reason }. Empty today: every occurrence of 399/2,999/250 in dist is Gymbo's own price (checked by reading each sentence, 2026-09-26).
